name: Afghanistan
shortSummary: India built extensive development ties with Afghanistan's republic-era governments, but the 2021 Taliban takeover forced a recalibration; India maintains a technical mission in Kabul without formal recognition of the Taliban government.
complexity: India does not formally recognise the Taliban administration, but has re-engaged through a "technical mission" in Kabul reopened in 2022 to manage humanitarian assistance and monitor security developments.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India has supplied wheat, medicines and vaccines through Pakistani land transit and other routes since 2021.

majorChallenges.title: Non-recognition of the Taliban
majorChallenges.description: India has not formally recognised the Taliban government, limiting the scope of official engagement.

majorChallenges.title: Security and humanitarian access
majorChallenges.description: Ongoing instability constrains project delivery and personnel safety.

recentDevelopments.title: Technical mission continues limited engagement
recentDevelopments.description: India's technical mission in Kabul, reopened in 2022, continued managing humanitarian assistance without formal recognition of the Taliban government.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Reflects a cautious, transactional re-engagement rather than a full normalization of ties.

historicalEvents.title: Zaranj-Delaram Highway
historicalEvents.description: India completes construction of a strategic highway linking Afghanistan to Iran's Chabahar port, bypassing Pakistan.

historicalEvents.title: Afghan Parliament Building
historicalEvents.description: India completes construction of the new Afghan Parliament complex in Kabul as a landmark development assistance project.

historicalEvents.title: Taliban Takeover
historicalEvents.description: The Taliban retakes Kabul as US and NATO forces withdraw; India evacuates its embassy staff and suspends formal diplomatic presence.
historicalEvents.impact: India paused development projects and diplomatic presence, later reopening a limited technical mission in 2022.
